answer_1.quote: Dialog State Tracking (DST) aims to capture user goals in the form of (slot, value) pairs... Our proposed method integrates multiple slot descriptions into a single query and generates all values in one pass, which improves performance without losing efficiency.
answer_1.outputs: The output y consists of slot-value pairs: {(s 1 , v 1 ), (s 2 , v 2 ), ..., (s n k , v n k )}.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate DST performance using the widely adopted Joint Goal Accuracy (JGA) , which requires all slots' values are correctly predicted.
